_help.note: File goc: dinh nghia cau truc huy hieu (metric, target, tier, order) VA ban tieng Anh. Sua o day de them / bot / doi huy hieu.
_help.localization: Ban dich nam o badges-<ngon-ngu>.json cung thu muc. File dich CHI chua id + title/description/hint - khong lap lai metric/target/tier. Muc nao thieu trong ban dich se tu dong dung tieng Anh.
_help.icon: KHONG CAN DIEN. Cu bo file anh vao assets/badges/icons/ dat ten theo id (vi du ic_first_workout.webp hoac first_workout.png) la app tu nhan. Khong co file -> app ve huy hieu theo tier + glyph.
